workflows.title: Low-power quiescence obligations
workflows.decision: Review owner-level drain, admission and shutdown prerequisites throughout a sampled power or clock transition.
intent_questions: Which independent owners, resources and remote responses must be drained before this shutdown?
Which admission, isolation and availability conditions must remain valid throughout the protected transition interval?
